{"category_edits":[{"category":"interest_aggregation","rationale":"Blend each causal encoder state with the masked mean of its latest five valid states using weights 0.9 and 0.1. This modest smoothing may stabilize sparse histories while preserving recent intent. Training and prediction share the same SASRec class; update both metadata identifiers accordingly.","edits":[{"find":"        states = self.last_layernorm(seq_emb)
        valid = (~timeline_mask).to(dtype=states.dtype)
        positions = torch.arange(M, device=seq.device)
        distance = positions.unsqueeze(1) - positions.unsqueeze(0)
        causal_weights = torch.exp(
            -math.log(2.0) * distance.clamp_min(0).to(states.dtype) / 5.0
        ) * distance.ge(0).to(states.dtype)
        weights = causal_weights.unsqueeze(0) * valid.unsqueeze(1)
        weights = weights / weights.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1e-8)
        pooled = torch.bmm(weights, states * valid.unsqueeze(-1))
        return (0.8 * states + 0.2 * pooled) * valid.unsqueeze(-1)","replace":"        states = self.last_layernorm(seq_emb)
        valid = (~timeline_mask).to(dtype=states.dtype)
        positions = torch.arange(M, device=seq.device)
        distance = positions.unsqueeze(1) - positions.unsqueeze(0)
        valid_counts = (~timeline_mask).long().cumsum(dim=1)
        valid_distance = valid_counts.unsqueeze(2) - valid_counts.unsqueeze(1)
        recent_causal = (
            distance.ge(0).unsqueeze(0)
            & valid_distance.ge(0)
            & valid_distance.lt(5)
        )
        weights = recent_causal.to(states.dtype) * valid.unsqueeze(1)
        weights = weights / weights.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1e-8)
        pooled = torch.bmm(weights, states * valid.unsqueeze(-1))
        return (0.9 * states + 0.1 * pooled) * valid.unsqueeze(-1)"},{"find":"            "interest_aggregation": "causal_recency_half_life_5_blend_0.2_v1",","replace":"            "interest_aggregation": "causal_last_5_valid_mean_blend_0.1_v1","},{"find":"        if meta.get("interest_aggregation") != "causal_recency_half_life_5_blend_0.2_v1":","replace":"        if meta.get("interest_aggregation") != "causal_last_5_valid_mean_blend_0.1_v1":"}]}],"change_summary":"Replace recency pooling with a 90% current-state / 10% latest-five-valid-state mean readout across all four datasets, preserving causal supervision and shared predictor behavior."}
